UPDATE players p
        SET points = sub.total
        FROM (
            SELECT pms.player_id, SUM(pms.points) AS total
            FROM player_match_stats pms
            JOIN fixtures f ON f.id = pms.fixture_id
            WHERE f.gameweek = $1
            GROUP BY pms.player_id
        ) sub
        WHERE p.id = sub.player_id
